onnx.post_export: removed node metadata pkg.torch.onnx.stack_trace (absolute local paths); weights and graph unchanged

output_semantics.meaning: relative, disparity-like depth; no metric units; scale and offset vary per image
output_semantics.range: non-negative (in-graph ReLU); no fixed upper bound
output_semantics.direction_evidence: visual check of 5 pinned upstream demo images (demo01/03/07/10/16), confirmed by the developer on 2026-10-23; not a metric measurement
output_semantics.postprocessing_outside_graph: crop any letterbox padding (none for the default stretch), then bilinear (half-pixel) resize to source size; display normalization (2nd-98th percentile) for visualization only

preprocessing.status: selected - stretch is the default (developer decision 2026-10-26, after comparing letterbox vs stretch on 12 local webcam stills and 2 bursts; see docs/preprocessing_comparison.json and docs/decisions.md); letterbox stays supported for tests and comparisons
preprocessing.input: HxWx3 RGB uint8 (callers convert BGR/BGRA/NV12 to RGB; alpha dropped)

aspect_policy.stretch: default: resize directly to 448 x 448 (aspect ratio not kept; a 16:9 frame is squeezed 1.78x horizontally); new = 448, pad = 0
aspect_policy.letterbox: supported: s = 448 / max(W, H); new = max(1, round(dim * s)) (round half to even); pad = (448 - new) // 2, centred

preprocessing.resize: bilinear, half-pixel centres, edge clamped; source u = (j + 0.5) * W / new_w - 0.5; separable, horizontal pass then vertical, float32
preprocessing.layout: NCHW, contiguous, float32, channel order R,G,B
preprocessing.inverse: crop [pad_y:pad_y+new_h, pad_x:pad_x+new_w] (the whole tensor for stretch) then the same bilinear resize to src size
preprocessing.coordinates: continuous, pixel i centre at i + 0.5; net = src * (new/src) + pad
